# DeepWiki

> > Conversational AI documentation platform that makes code repository documentation interactive and queryable through natural language.

DeepWiki indexes and documents popular open-source repositories across AI, backend infrastructure, and developer tools, enabling developers to understand complex codebases through conversational AI interfaces. The platform covers critical technologies in machine learning frameworks, LLM infrastructure, web automation, and distributed systems.

## Key Topics

- LLM Integration
- System Architecture
- API Documentation
- AI Frameworks
- Document Processing
- Distributed Systems
- Python SDK
- Developer Tools
- TypeScript
- Machine Learning
- Web Automation
- Data Infrastructure
- Code Documentation
- Testing Frameworks
- In-Memory Storage

## LLM & AI Frameworks

- [langchain-ai/langchain](https://deepwiki.com/langchain-ai/langchain): Modular framework for building LLM applications with composable abstractions
- [huggingface/transformers](https://deepwiki.com/huggingface/transformers): 400+ model implementations for NLP, vision, audio, and multimodal tasks
- [karpathy/nanochat](https://deepwiki.com/karpathy/nanochat): Complete LLM training and deployment system with complexity dial design
- [eosphoros-ai/DB-GPT](https://deepwiki.com/eosphoros-ai/DB-GPT): AI-native data application framework for LLM infrastructure and workflows
- [agent0ai/agent-zero](https://deepwiki.com/agent0ai/agent-zero): AI agent framework with LLM integration and multi-agent capabilities
- [infiniflow/ragflow](https://deepwiki.com/infiniflow/ragflow): Open-source RAG engine combining document understanding with conversational AI

## API Clients & SDKs

- [openai/openai-python](https://deepwiki.com/openai/openai-python): Official type-safe Python client for OpenAI REST API with async support
- [anthropics/anthropic-sdk-python](https://deepwiki.com/anthropics/anthropic-sdk-python): Official Claude API client with sync/async and tool system
- [colinhacks/zod](https://deepwiki.com/colinhacks/zod): TypeScript schema validation library with runtime type checking and inference

## Infrastructure & Data Systems

- [redis/redis](https://deepwiki.com/redis/redis): In-memory data store with architecture, persistence, replication, and clustering
- [celery/celery](https://deepwiki.com/celery/celery): Distributed task queue framework with worker architecture and message brokers
- [Tencent/ncnn](https://deepwiki.com/Tencent/ncnn): High-performance neural network inference framework for mobile and edge devices

## Developer Tools & Utilities

- [microsoft/vscode](https://deepwiki.com/microsoft/vscode): VS Code architecture overview: source layout, multi-process runtime, and subsystems
- [microsoft/playwright](https://deepwiki.com/microsoft/playwright): Cross-browser web automation and testing framework for Chromium, Firefox, and WebKit
- [mermaid-js/mermaid](https://deepwiki.com/mermaid-js/mermaid): Diagram visualization library with architecture and rendering pipeline
- [nextapps-de/flexsearch](https://deepwiki.com/nextapps-de/flexsearch): High-performance full-text search library for browser and Node.js

## Document Processing & Optimization

- [opendatalab/MinerU](https://deepwiki.com/opendatalab/MinerU): Document parsing tool converting PDFs and images to Markdown and JSON
- [linshenkx/prompt-optimizer](https://deepwiki.com/linshenkx/prompt-optimizer): Multi-platform AI prompt optimization tool with monorepo architecture

## Optional

- [hackjutsu/Lepton](https://deepwiki.com/hackjutsu/Lepton): Code snippet manager Electron app with GitHub integration and desktop features
- [DeepWiki Homepage](https://deepwiki.com): Conversational AI documentation platform for code repositories
